patches.summary: Hand-built `records bulk-upsert` wrapper adding --merge-on, --batch-progress, --stdin, and automatic 10-record batching over the generated records upsert path.
patches.reason: Airtable caps upserts at 10 records per request, so file/stdin-driven ingest pipelines need a batching wrapper the generator doesn't emit. The wrapper preserves the generated body shape and forwards each batch through the generated client.
patches.validated_outcome: Builds, registers under `records` group, and forwards through the generated upsert client per-batch with stderr progress lines.
